verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only thread resumption (`resume the most recent thread`), thread cloning, and a local SQLite or remote database for storage. These are session-continuity and storage features, not documented automatic memory that the agent builds and recalls across sessions. Nothing describes the agent extracting, persisting, or automatically recalling learned facts or project knowledge in new sessions, so this adjacent support earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent build and recall memory automatically across sessions
